instruction: Please help me configure VS Code to auto-generate unit tests by analyzing my voice commands.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have built-in voice command recognition or voice-controlled test generation capabilities. Such features would require external tools and are not part of VS Code's core functionality.
